Hires, trains, schedules, evaluates and oversees work of Resident Care Aides.
Responsible for creating and implementing quality programs to engage memory care residents. Assures residents are engaged in a meaningful program respectful of individual needs.

Responsible for designing, implementing and monitoring facility processes and procedures to assure compliance with all appropriate regulatory and accrediting agencies. Works in collaboration with department managers and staff to implement and maintain processes for regulatory compliance. Maintains records, policy and procedure manuals for memory care. Maintains and audits files necessary for Department of Social Services compliance.
Observes changes in resident health; provides assistance and consultation to them and their families concerning ongoing health-related problems. Communicates regularly with family members.
Controls supply budget and orders supplies as needed.
Maintains a positive working relationship with all other departments.
